nodes.description: Mapping address => uint256 tracking ETH deposited before tokens were bought.
Mapping address => uint256 tracking ETH sent after the token purchase (refund tracking).
Boolean flag indicating the contract already forwarded ETH to the sale.
Boolean flag indicating the ERC20 token address has been configured.
Boolean flag indicating Enjin refunded the contributed ETH.
Total ETH value the contract contributed to the sale; used as denominator in token math.
Boolean flag that disables purchases.
Hardcoded keccak256 hash used as an alternative authentication secret.
Privileged developer address (default 0x0639C169D9265Ca4B4DEce693764CdA8ea5F3882).
Address of the Enjin sale multisig that receives the contributed ETH.
ERC20 instance used for token distribution.
Minimum ETH required (3235 ether) before the buy is triggered.
Developer-only function that sets the token contract address.
Developer-only function that toggles the refunded flag.
Enables the kill switch; callable by developer or by presenting a password matching password_hash.
Withdraws ETH or proportional tokens for msg.sender based on recorded balances.
Withdraws using a caller-supplied token address instead of the configured one.
Developer-only function forwarding the whole balance to the sale.
Payable fallback recording deposits or after-buy refunds and triggering the buy.
Caller-controlled address used for authentication, balance accounting and refund destination.
sale.call.value(contract_eth_value)() forwarding all ETH via a low-level call in purchase_tokens.
sale.call.value(contract_eth_value)() forwarding all ETH via a low-level call inside the fallback.
msg.sender.transfer(...) sending ETH out in personal_withdraw.
token.transfer(...) calls distributing tokens and the developer fee in personal_withdraw.
msg.sender.transfer(...) sending ETH out in withdraw_token.
myToken.transfer(...) calls distributing tokens and the developer fee in withdraw_token.
Parameter _token of set_token: the ERC20 address to register.
Parameter _refunded of set_refunded: new value of the refunded flag.
Parameter password of activate_kill_switch: pre-image expected to hash to password_hash.
Parameter _token of withdraw_token: caller-supplied ERC20 address.
Local eth_to_withdraw_after_buy in personal_withdraw, snapshot of the post-buy balance.
Local eth_to_withdraw in personal_withdraw, snapshot of the pre-buy balance.
Local contract_token_balance in personal_withdraw, token balance of the contract.
Local tokens_to_withdraw in personal_withdraw, proportional token amount.
Local fee in personal_withdraw, 1% developer fee.
Local myToken in withdraw_token, the caller-supplied ERC20 instance.
Local eth_to_withdraw_after_buy in withdraw_token.
Local eth_to_withdraw in withdraw_token.
Local contract_token_balance in withdraw_token.
Local tokens_to_withdraw in withdraw_token.
Local fee in withdraw_token, 1% developer fee.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines balances read and is the ETH transfer recipient in personal_withdraw, enabling re-entrant withdraw calls before accounting settles.
msg.sender selects the balance and receives ETH/tokens in withdraw_token.
msg.sender indexes balances/balances_after_buy and can trigger the low-level call in the fallback.
purchase_tokens requires msg.sender == developer, an authentication check on caller input.
set_token requires msg.sender == developer; developer value gates authorization.
set_refunded requires msg.sender == developer.
activate_kill_switch allows msg.sender == developer or a password hash match.
msg.sender must equal developer before the low-level sale call executes in purchase_tokens.
set_token writes the token state variable.
set_token writes token_set = true.
set_refunded writes the refunded state variable.
activate_kill_switch writes kill_switch = true.
password_hash is compared against sha3(password) in activate_kill_switch.
contract_eth_value is the divisor in token math and is decremented, risking division by zero / underflow.
personal_withdraw reads and zeroes balances_after_buy before an ETH transfer.
balances[msg.sender] is read, multiplied and used as an operand, risking overflow/underflow.
personal_withdraw branches on bought_tokens.
personal_withdraw branches on refunded.
personal_withdraw requires token_set before token distribution.
personal_withdraw calls token.balanceOf and token.transfer on the configured token.
personal_withdraw performs msg.sender.transfer, an external value transfer.
personal_withdraw performs token.transfer calls to developer and msg.sender.
withdraw_token reads and zeroes balances_after_buy before an ETH transfer.
balances[msg.sender] is used in multiplication and subtraction in withdraw_token.
withdraw_token branches on bought_tokens.
withdraw_token branches on refunded.
contract_eth_value is the divisor and is decremented in withdraw_token.
withdraw_token performs msg.sender.transfer, an external value transfer.
withdraw_token performs myToken.transfer calls to developer and msg.sender.
purchase_tokens requires sale != 0 and calls sale.
purchase_tokens compares this.balance against eth_minimum.
purchase_tokens sets bought_tokens = true.
purchase_tokens sets contract_eth_value = this.balance.
purchase_tokens returns early when kill_switch is set.
purchase_tokens executes a low-level value call to sale, an external interaction point.
fallback uses sale for comparison and as the call target.
fallback compares this.balance against eth_minimum.
fallback branches on and sets bought_tokens.
fallback sets and reads contract_eth_value.
fallback returns early when kill_switch is set.
fallback sets refunded = true when the sale refunds.
fallback executes a low-level value call to sale, an external interaction point reachable by any depositor.
Parameter _token feeds set_token.
Parameter _refunded feeds set_refunded.
Parameter password feeds activate_kill_switch hashing.
Parameter _token feeds withdraw_token.
_token is cast to ERC20 and stored into token.
_token is cast into the myToken local in withdraw_token.
personal_withdraw declares eth_to_withdraw_after_buy.
personal_withdraw declares eth_to_withdraw.
personal_withdraw declares contract_token_balance.
personal_withdraw declares tokens_to_withdraw.
personal_withdraw declares fee.
withdraw_token declares myToken.
withdraw_token declares eth_to_withdraw_after_buy.
withdraw_token declares eth_to_withdraw.
withdraw_token declares contract_token_balance.
withdraw_token declares tokens_to_withdraw.
withdraw_token declares fee.

normalization_plan.reason: Local input parameter only meaningful for the set_token authorization flow and its token assignment.
Parameter exists only to set the refunded state variable inside set_refunded.
Password pre-image is consumed only by the hash check in activate_kill_switch.
Caller-supplied token address is only used by the withdraw_token distribution logic.
Temporary snapshot variable of the personal_withdraw withdrawal flow.
Value immediately transferred out via msg.sender.transfer in personal_withdraw.
Intermediate balance used for the proportional token calculation.
Computed amount is directly transferred by the token transfers in personal_withdraw.
Fee amount is transferred to the developer by token.transfer in personal_withdraw.
Caller-supplied ERC20 instance used only by withdraw_token.
Temporary snapshot variable of the withdraw_token withdrawal flow.
Value immediately transferred out via msg.sender.transfer in withdraw_token.
Intermediate balance used for the proportional token calculation.
Computed amount is directly transferred by the token transfers in withdraw_token.
Fee amount is transferred to the developer by myToken.transfer in withdraw_token.
